story: Comparison 19 s: a cheap yellow-handled knife (cold light) vs our chef knife (warm light), cut back and forth on the same three tests: tomato, sheet of paper, crusty bread. Ends on a hero shot. Add captions "them / us" in the edit.
storyboard_prompts: Image 1 is the product photo: use exactly this product, its shape, materials, colours and logos. Create ONE storyboard image made of a 2x2 grid of four equal photo panels, edge to edge, with no borders, no gaps, no text and no numbers. Shot on a 35mm film camera, Kodak Portra 400, visible film grain, slight halation around highlights, natural unretouched colours, a real photograph, not a render. Comparison ad, 9:16 vertical frame, the same top-down 45-degree view of a pale wooden cutting board in every shot, 50mm lens. Handheld: the frame drifts and bobs slightly, focus breathes and lands a moment late. Only the same person's hands and forearms: real skin with fine pores, knuckle creases, a faint vein on the back of the hand, short natural nails. Panel 1 (top left): THEM, tomato: a cheap thin knife with a dull wavy serrated blade and a scratched bright-yellow plastic handle presses down on a ripe red tomato, squashing it flat, juice and seeds bursting out. THEM: flat cold bluish fluorescent light, dull and lifeless. Panel 2 (top right): US, tomato: a professional chef knife: a wide polished stainless steel blade with a fine satin finish and a curved edge, a steel bolster, and a smooth black ergonomic handle glides through a ripe red tomato, leaving thin, perfect, clean slices. US: warm golden window light from the left, crisp shadows to the right. Panel 3 (bottom left): THEM, paper: a cheap thin knife with a dull wavy serrated blade and a scratched bright-yellow plastic handle tears a sheet of white paper held up in the air, a ragged crumpled edge. THEM: flat cold bluish fluorescent light, dull and lifeless. Panel 4 (bottom right): US, paper: a professional chef knife: a wide polished stainless steel blade with a fine satin finish and a curved edge, a steel bolster, and a smooth black ergonomic handle slices cleanly through a sheet of white paper held up in the air, a straight crisp cut. US: warm golden window light from the left, crisp shadows to the right. The same board, hands and framing in all four panels; only the knife and light change. Candid, unretouched photographs with natural imperfections: real crumbs, dust, fingerprints, uneven light, slight lens vignetting. No extra products, no added text, no watermark.
